title: Bounded fibre-dimension loci pulled back from a Noetherian model
statement: Let $h_0:X_0\to S_0$ and $g:S\to S_0$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $h_0$ locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Assume $X_0$ is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Form $X=X_0\times_{S_0}S$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $h:X\to S$ and $q:X\to X_0$, and assume $q$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For each integer $n\ge0$ set $L_{0,n}=\{x_0\in X_0\mid\dim_{x_0}((X_0)_{h_0(x_0)})\le n\}$ and $L_n=\{x\in X\mid\dim_x(X_{h(x)})\le n\}$, using scheme-theoretic fibres [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and topological dimension at their distinguished points [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]. Then $L_n=q^{-1}(L_{0,n})$, and both $L_{0,n}\subset X_0$ and $L_n\subset X$ are open and quasi-compact. No finite-presentation hypothesis on $h_0$ and no Noetherian hypothesis on $X$ or $S$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 00QJ, lemma-dimension-fibres-bounded-quasi-compact-open-upstairs, proof: inverse-image paragraph and final Noetherian quasi-compactness sentence, with the Noetherian-source and quasi-compact-projection hypotheses made explicit

proof.text: Fix $n\ge0$. For each $x\in X$, put $x_0=q(x)$ and $s=h(x)$. The cartesian square gives $h_0(x_0)=g(s)$. Apply [lem-sc-fibre-dimension-after-base-change] to $h_0$, $g$ and $x$: its local-dimension equality is $\dim_x X_s=\dim_{x_0}(X_0)_{h_0(x_0)}$. Thus $x\in L_n$ if and only if $q(x)\in L_{0,n}$, proving $L_n=q^{-1}(L_{0,n})$ by equality of memberships. Only local finite type of $h_0$ is required.

source.place: Tag 02FY, lemma-dimension-fibre-after-base-change, part (1); used in the inverse-image argument of Algebra Tag 00QJ

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-local-fibre-dimension-open] to the locally finite type morphism $h_0$ and the integer $n$: $L_{0,n}$ is open. The underlying map of the scheme morphism $q$ is continuous, so its inverse image is open. Step 1 identifies this inverse image with $L_n$.

source.place: Tag 02FZ, lemma-openness-bounded-dimension-fibres; Algebra Tag 00QJ, opening and inverse-image sentences

proof.text: By local Noetherianity [pqf-def-locnoeth], choose an affine open cover of $X_0$ with Noetherian coordinate rings. Quasi-compactness of $X_0$ [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] gives a finite subcover $U_1,\ldots,U_r$. Each $U_i$ has Noetherian underlying space by [lem-sc-affine-noetherian-underlying-space]. By [lem-sfb-noetherian-space-compact-subsets], $L_{0,n}\cap U_i$ is quasi-compact. To check quasi-compactness of $L_{0,n}$ directly, restrict any open cover of it to each intersection, choose a finite subcover there, and take the union of these finitely many finite families. Every point lies in some $U_i$, so the resulting family covers $L_{0,n}$. If $X_0$ is empty, take $r=0$ and the empty subcover.

source.place: Tag 01OZ, lemma-Noetherian-topology, finite affine cover argument; Topology Tag 04ZA, lemma-Noetherian-quasi-compact; Algebra Tag 00QJ, final sentence

proof.text: The morphism $q$ is quasi-compact by hypothesis, and $L_{0,n}$ is open by Step 2 and quasi-compact by Step 3. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-morphism-preimage-qc-open] to $q$ and this open: $q^{-1}(L_{0,n})$ is quasi-compact. By Step 1 this is $L_n$. These arguments use no finite presentation of $h_0$ and no Noetherianity of $X$ or $S$.

lean.statement: theorem noetherianModel_localFibreDimension_locus_pullback {X₀ S₀ S : Scheme.{u}} (h₀ : X₀ ⟶ S₀) [LocallyOfFiniteType h₀] [IsLocallyNoetherian X₀] [CompactSpace X₀] (g : S ⟶ S₀) [QuasiCompact (pullback.fst h₀ g)] (n : ℕ) : {x : ↥(pullback h₀ g) | topologicalKrullDimAt ((pullback.snd h₀ g).asFiber x) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)} = (pullback.fst h₀ g) ⁻¹' {x₀ : X₀ | topologicalKrullDimAt (h₀.asFiber x₀) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)} ∧ (IsOpen {x₀ : X₀ | topologicalKrullDimAt (h₀.asFiber x₀) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)} ∧ IsCompact {x₀ : X₀ | topologicalKrullDimAt (h₀.asFiber x₀) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)}) ∧ (IsOpen {x : ↥(pullback h₀ g) | topologicalKrullDimAt ((pullback.snd h₀ g).asFiber x) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)} ∧ IsCompact {x : ↥(pullback h₀ g) | topologicalKrullDimAt ((pullback.snd h₀ g).asFiber x) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)})
